skill.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skill.description: Guides users in splitting independent coding tasks across multiple AI agents for parallel investigation and integration.
skill.summary: Plan, dispatch, and integrate independent AI agent tasks for faster debugging and review.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

content.value_statement: Sequential debugging slows teams when failures are independent. This skill shows how to split scoped tasks across Claude, Codex, and Claude Code agents.
actual_capabilities: Helps decide when independent failures should be assigned to separate agents.
Provides a decision flow for choosing parallel or sequential investigation.
Defines focused agent prompts with scope, goal, constraints, and expected output.
Shows examples for debugging failing test files with parallel agent tasks.
Includes integration checks for summaries, conflicts, tests, and spot review.
limitations: Does not provide executable automation or agent management code.
Requires tasks to be independent before parallel dispatch is useful.
Uses coding and test failure examples, so other teams must adapt the wording.
Requires human review before integrating agent results.

use_cases.title: Split Test Failure Triage
use_cases.description: Assign independent failing test files to separate agents, then combine verified fixes after full test runs.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Review Investigations
use_cases.description: Send unrelated review concerns to focused agents and collect short summaries for final maintainer judgment.

use_cases.title: Organize Multi-Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Create clear task boundaries, expected outputs, and integration checks for teams using AI coding assistants.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Independent Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: I have several coding problems. Group them by independent problem domain and tell me which ones can be assigned to separate agents.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Focused Agent Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Create ready-to-send prompts for simple parallel work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these independent failures into focused agent prompts. Each prompt needs scope, goal, constraints, and expected output.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Integration Checks
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare to merge several agent results safely.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these planned agent tasks, define the review, conflict check, test run, and spot check steps for final integration.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Parallel Dispatch Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation before running many agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this parallel agent plan. Identify shared state risks, missing context, weak constraints, and tasks that should stay sequential.

output_examples.input: Three unrelated test files are failing after a refactor.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend one agent per test file, with clear scope and a final full-suite verification step.

output_examples.input: A user asks whether two failures should be investigated together.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare shared state and root cause signals, then recommend parallel or sequential investigation.

output_examples.input: Several agents return summaries after separate fixes.
output: Read each summary for root cause and changed files.
Check whether edits overlap or change shared behavior.
Run the full suite and spot check for repeated mistakes.

best_practices: Dispatch agents only after confirming tasks have independent context and low shared-state risk.
Give each agent one scope, one goal, explicit constraints, and a required summary.
Review summaries, check conflicts, run full tests, and spot check before integration.
anti_patterns: Sending broad prompts like fix all tests to a single agent without scoped domains.
Dispatching parallel agents when failures may share one root cause.
Integrating agent changes without conflict review, full tests, and human spot checks.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when two or more coding tasks are independent and can be investigated without shared context.

faq.question: Does this skill run agents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow and prompt structure for using agents in supported AI coding tools.

faq.question: Can I use it outside debugging?
faq.answer: Yes. The same pattern works for independent review, documentation, migration, or investigation tasks.

faq.question: What makes a task safe for parallel dispatch?
faq.answer: A safe task has a clear scope, independent files or behavior, and limited risk of editing shared state.

faq.question: How should I review agent results?
faq.answer: Read each summary, inspect changed areas, check for conflicts, run tests, and spot check for repeated errors.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools for this workflow.
